# PART 3 – Reproduction and exploration {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3 · 90 minutes

::: notes
Welcome back – and if you are just rejoining, the catch-up card in the chat has everything you missed. This is the coding-heavy part of the day. This morning was concepts, and now we put them to work. You reproduce my submitted result to the third decimal, from my own code. Then we open the menu of choices I could have made instead – and there are more of them than you would guess – go through what each one does to the model, and then you spend the last stretch working the menu yourself. By the end of it you will have a feel for which of those choices actually move the answer.
:::
